entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A black body at the 2,400 K dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse in the Kepler band (Esteves et al. 2015, dayside brightness temperature in the Kepler band, assuming no reflected light): #ffa041. Read from the paper (Table 5): the paper's value (+100, -200 K; the larger is kept) from an eclipse 26 ± 10 ppm deep; no infrared eclipse is published. Reflected starlight is not included.
